parameters.read_layout: per instance: one flag byte, the block the write frame carries, then padding up to read_stride (measured with this project's own cat 0x07 read; instance 0 held the block the vendor panel last wrote)
parameters.notes: Tube176. Each listed control was wheeled to both ends in the vendor panel and moved only its own bytes; min/max are the raw limits seen. Raw units: no physical unit is claimed. Bytes of the block not listed here (switches, menus, stacked rings the wheel did not reach) are unmapped and are written back unchanged. Fields appended after Output (Ratio): ported from the Zen Go, not captured on this device. They were mapped from vendor-panel captures on the owner's Zen Go (same effect type and block); the value meanings below are copied from the Zen Go note: Ratio = the COMP. RATIO knob: 0-3 = 2:1, 4:1, 8:1, 12:1. Discrete 4 live trial 2026-11-22: loaded alone into the channel 3 rack through this project, every control moved by one step and put back, each write confirmed by readback.
